W.name: Rink World Frame
W.origin: Center-ice faceoff dot on the ice surface (z = 0)

axes.+X: Toward attacking goal along rink longitudinal centerline
axes.+Z: Vertically upward normal to ice surface (+X cross +Y = +Z)
Upward along spine toward head (+X cross +Y = +Z)

S.name: Sensor Chip Frame (Canonical Vertical Sternum PCB)

axes.+Z: Outward normal to PCB away from chest (+X_B, +X cross +Y = +Z)

position.tolerance: 2.5-6.0 m CEP50 per 45 s shift with bench-gate + RTS (>10-25 m unbounded without bench/wall resets)

pressure.tolerance: 0.015625 Pa/LSB (+/- 3.0 Pa relative, < 0.1 Pa RMS noise)

buses.SPIM1: 8 MHz SPI Mode 0, 1.8 V isolated <=10 MHz max (ADXL372, CS_HIGHG_N)
buses.TWIM0: 400 kHz I2C0 Fast Mode, 1.8 V (MMC5983MA 0x30, BMP581 0x47 [SDO=1V8; alt 0x46])
buses.QSPI: 48-96 MHz Quad SPI SDR, 1.8 V (W25N01JW 1 Gbit / 128 MiB SLC NAND, 998 usable blocks)
buses.USBD: USB 2.0 Full-Speed 12 Mbps CDC-ACM (VBUS powered download + charging)
buses.BLE: BLE 5.3 2M PHY 2.4 GHz (GATT NUS / L2CAP CoC secondary offload)

SESSION_HEADER.description: 80 B payload (104 B frame): session metadata, sensor ODRs, exact scales, rink preset, mount, height, bench gate

IMU_BATCH.description: 8+12*N B payload (nominal N=20 -> 248 B payload, 272 B frame): primary 6-DOF ICM-42688-P batch in sensor frame S

HIGH_G_BATCH.description: 8+6*N B payload (e.g. N=32 -> 200 B payload, 224 B frame): ADXL372 right-aligned >>4 12-bit int16 [-2048,+2047] at 0.980665 (m/s^2)/LSB

AUX_ENV.description: 28 B payload (52 B frame, 50 Hz): MMC5983MA centered 18-bit mag, BMP581 pressure_pa_x64, baro/batt temp, vbatt, soc, pmic_status, validity_flags

EVENT_MARKER.description: 16 B payload (40 B frame): async event marker (codes 1..8, severity 0..3, value_f32, detail_u64)

CALIBRATION_BLOCK.description: 288 B payload (312 B frame): ICM & ADXL372 R_BS matrices, misalign/scale matrices, biases, mag hard/soft-iron, baseline norm/dip, CRC32

SESSION_FOOTER.description: 72 B payload (96 B frame): end UTC, IMU/high-g/aux counts, dropped counts, end_reason, total_bytes, pre_footer_sha256[32]

header_b64.description: Base64-encoded 416 B concatenated 0x01 header frame (104 B) + 0x06 calibration frame (312 B)

pmic_status.description: Primary nPM1300 status flags (bits [7:0] of AUX_ENV pmic_status)
